Satisfying place for all tastes
Oct 2025 • Couples
On the river, inside the evening souvenir market this modern place with simple and elegant dark furnishings, certainly welcomes crowds of tourists. The menu is oriented towards both traditional Vietnamese dishes and European proposals. Excellent fried stuffed courgette flowers and, pleasant for us Italians, baguette bruschetta with garlic that we used as bread throughout the meal. Good squid in salad with pineapple and noodels with seafood. We tried, paying a fair price, a Vietnamese white made with a variety of grapes that in Europe is table: simple but well made and good for seafood dishes. Service always quick, efficient and courteous. Local satisfactory therefore for all tastes.
